title: FuzzEvidenceRecord
description: One normalized harness-fuzz signal, written to data/fuzz_results/divergences.jsonl. A signal is ONLY promoted to the fuzz_attacker_synthesis specialist when status == 'confirmed' (reproduced AND harness/oracle artifact ruled out). This is the fuzz-lane false-positive guard that protects precision before the existing FP gauntlet.

evidence_id.description: Unique id: FZ-<three+ digits>, e.g. FZ-001

harness_kind.description: differential = diff two implementations against a reference oracle; property = falsify a stated invariant via a negative-controlled property test

invariant.description: The property/invariant tested or the divergence axis (e.g. 'reserve_x*reserve_y non-decreasing after swap', 'aurora==revm state')

falsified.description: property harness: invariant was broken. differential harness: a divergence was observed. A HELD invariant (falsified=false) is a legitimate NEGATIVE result and never becomes a finding.

status.description: confirmed = reproduced AND artifact_ruled_out (the ONLY status promoted to synthesis). harness_artifact = the signal is caused by the harness/oracle, not the SUT (rejected). unreproduced = could not be deterministically reproduced (held back). held = invariant held / no divergence (negative result).

reproduced.description: Re-running the deterministic seed / counterexample reproduces the signal.

artifact_ruled_out.description: The harness/oracle was ruled out as the cause. differential -> tie-break oracle (e.g. geth t8n) agrees the SUT, not the harness, is wrong. property -> negative-control passed (the same property HOLDS under a minimal correctness patch / on a reference impl), proving the property and harness are well-formed.

tie_break.description: differential harness only: the third-implementation tie-break result.

agrees_with.description: which side the oracle matches: 'reference' (=> SUT bug) | 'sut' (=> harness/reference bug) | 'neither'

negative_control.description: property harness only: proof the property+harness are well-formed.

passed.description: true if the property HELD under the minimal correctness patch / reference (so the falsification on the real code is meaningful, not a broken harness)

patch_note.description: the one-line minimal patch that makes the invariant hold (e.g. 'assert!(provided_liq>0)')

counterexample.description: The minimized failing case the synthesis agent reasons over and a PoC can replay.

seed.description: deterministic seed / rng state to regenerate the case

call_sequence.description: ordered ops that break the invariant (e.g. ['add_liquidity(1e6,1e6)','add_liquidity(1,1)'])

test_file.description: path to the runnable harness test that reproduces it

location.description: Best-effort source locus the signal implicates (function/file) so synthesis + dedup can map it.
